title: Quasi-finiteness at a prime is unchanged by principal localizations
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a ring map of finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], let $\mathfrak q\subset S$ be a prime ideal and $\mathfrak p=\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$. Let $f\in R$ with $f\notin\mathfrak p$ and $g\in S$ with $g\notin\mathfrak q$. Let $R_f$ be the localization of $R$ at $f$ and $S_{fg}$ the localization of $S$ at $\varphi(f)g$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away], with the ring map $R_f\to S_{fg}$, $r/f^n\mapsto \varphi(r)g^n/(\varphi(f)g)^n$, induced by $\varphi$ (it is of finite type), and let $\mathfrak qS_{fg}=\{y/(\varphi(f)g)^n\mid y\in\mathfrak q\}$, a prime ideal of $S_{fg}$. Then $R\to S$ is quasi-finite at $\mathfrak q$ [def-weil-pbc-ring-map-quasi-finite-at-prime] if and only if $R_f\to S_{fg}$ is quasi-finite at $\mathfrak qS_{fg}$.

proof.text: Put h = algebraMap R S f * g and T = Localization.Away h. Equip T with the supplied R_f-algebra structure. The commuting-square equation supplies IsScalarTower R R_f T. Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Away.AdjoinRoot provides Algebra.FiniteType R T; Algebra.FiniteType.of_restrictScalars_finiteType gives Algebra.FiniteType R_f T.

Primality and the two nonmembership hypotheses give h not in q, hence all powers of h avoid q. Mathlib IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint proves qT prime, and IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint proves its contraction is q. These are the prime-correspondence parts of Stacks Tag 00E3; no local-ring or residue-field isomorphism is required.

Work with the topological fibres of the maps of prime spectra. Write a : Spec S -> Spec R, b : Spec T -> Spec R_f, i : Spec T -> Spec S, j : Spec R_f -> Spec R. Mathlib PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_isOpenEmbedding makes i an open embedding and PrimeSpectrum.localization_comap_injective makes j injective. The square hypothesis gives a(i(x)) = j(b(x)). For the extended prime x, injectivity of j identifies B = b^{-1}({b(x)}) with i^{-1}(A), where A = a^{-1}({a(i(x))}). Transport along this equality by Homeomorph.setCongr and use Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.restrictPreimage. The resulting B -> A is an open embedding carrying x to i(x) = q.

The image of the singleton {x} under this restricted open embedding is {q}. IsOpenEmbedding.isOpen_iff_image_isOpen therefore equates their openness in the respective topological fibres. PrimeSpectrum.preimageHomeomorphFiber, using Homeomorph.isOpen_image and Set.image_singleton, equates openness in each topological fibre with the fibre-ring-spectrum definition Algebra.IsQuasiFiniteAtPrime. Combine these two equivalences and supply the finite-type and prime-extension proofs from steps 1 and 2.

proof_origin.place: Lemma Tag 077H and its proof: the fibre of the localized map is homeomorphic to an open subset of the original fibre. K1 formalizes this directly on topological fibres using the injective base-spectrum map and the open embedding on target spectra, with Mathlib preimageHomeomorphFiber translating the existing fibre-ring definition. The prime extension uses Tag 00E3. No unit-level route is changed.

split_report.summary: Split into 9 steps following Stacks 077H, whose proof only says that the fibre of Spec(S_fg) -> Spec(R_f) is homeomorphic to an open subset of the fibre of Spec(S) -> Spec(R). Written out: (1) R_f -> S_fg is the map given by the universal property of localization and is of finite type; (2) qS_fg is prime over q, p' = pR_f, kappa(p) = kappa(p') (00E3 via lem-weil-pbc-localization-prime-residue-field-iso); (3) the fibre rings F, F' and their points, h = phi(f)g, its image in F not in the point and f a unit in F; (4)-(6) the ring isomorphism F_h ~ S_h (x)_{R_f} kappa(p') built from the pushout universal property of tensor products of algebras and the universal property of principal localization, inverse checked on generators; (7) it carries the point qbar F_h to qbar'; (8) Spec F_h -> D(hbar) is a homeomorphism (open immersion leaf, 00E4); (9) a point of an open subspace is isolated there iff isolated in the whole space, and the definition. Statement unchanged. No new node: all facts are existing nodes. Mathlib: kept unsplit-candidate (B8), searches recorded.
